title: Creamy Chicken Gravy
description: This recipe for creamy chicken gravy with red onion, garlic, thyme, and milk needs time to simmer and develop that rich, thick texture perfect for dinner.
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic, minced, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium-high heat; add red onion. Sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Season with thyme, salt, and black pepper.

Pour wine into the saucepan; simmer until wine has reduced, about 3 minutes. Pour in chicken broth, milk, and bouillon; stir. Reduce heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer until flavors meld, about 1 hour.
Combine water and flour in a bowl until thoroughly blended. Slowly stir flour mixture into gravy while continuously stirring. Simmer until thickened, 15 to 30 minutes more.
